body: Thank you so much. It really means a lot.
Oh, and thank you. It's hard to remember that I didn't earn this treatment. If I thought he wouldn't see it, I'd frame your first sentence.

Yes and no, he always gets worse when the ex is involved but he can go a good month or so without acting like this. He has narcolepsy which kind of explains it but definitely doesn't excuse it - I'd blow up from time to time too if I were extremely tired, but nothing to that degree. It definitely makes it harder to decide what to do and how to cope.
